provider: Yandex 360 "Для профи" (Profi) 3 TB — the regional price floor with unlimited public-link download

free_tier.stated: 3 TB / 5 TB / 10 TB / 20 TB / 30 TB tiers under Profi. 3 TB is the value tier: 990 ₽/mo list, 495 ₽/mo when paid annually (50 % annual discount is the steady state, not a short promo — the crossed-out 990 ₽ is the monthly rate). Upload per file: 100 GB. Monthly upload ceiling: 3× your Disk size.

egress.terms: FREE and explicitly unlimited: the plan comparison table states «Неограниченное скачивание по публичным ссылкам» (unlimited downloading via public links) and «Неограниченный доступ по вашим публичным ссылкам». No per-GB egress line exists anywhere in Yandex 360 consumer pricing — you cannot buy extra traffic because none is metered.

tooling: WebDAV endpoint live: `curl https://webdav.yandex.ru/` -> HTTP 302 to auth (expected; the mount is up). rclone `yandex` backend, rclone `webdav` with an app password, alist/OpenList `yandex` driver, official REST Disk API at cloud-api.yandex.net, plus the desktop client for Linux/Windows/macOS.
chaining: Cannot be pooled: one Yandex ID = one Disk. But the Family plan gives 1 TB to each of up to 8 members on one subscription (250 ₽/mo annual ≈ $3.03/TB), which is the cheapest legitimate multiplication path in this entire dossier. Profi and Family can be stacked — Yandex's own FAQ says the Disk volume sums across two plans on one account.
limits_note: The binding constraint is the UPLOAD side, not egress: «Месячный лимит загрузки на Диск до 3 объёмов Диска» (3× Disk size per month). On a 3 TB plan that is a 9 TB/month write ceiling — fine for the 20 TiB archive written once, fatal for a churning 10 TiB hot set. Per-object cap 100 GB on Profi. Public-link download is untimed and unthrottled but served from Yandex's own edge, not a CDN you control.
reliability_note: Two real risks. (1) PRICE DISCRIMINATION IS DOCUMENTED AND MEASURABLE: the same page carries a «Оплата картой другой страны» (payment by a foreign card) block that routes to a separate tariff sheet, and the USD sheet at 360.yandex.com/premium-plans publishes $12.50/mo for 3 TB Pro versus 495 ₽ (~$5.99) on the RUB sheet — a 2.09× markup for exactly for a user. Budget the USD number, not the rouble one. (2) Non-payment locks access progressively and then fully at 44 days (yandex.ru/support/disk/enlarge/disk-space.html) — so this is not a set-and-forget archive unless the card keeps working.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
